source.title: Kit 31203 grid projection fitted to the kit's land/sea mask
source.method: Land fraction of ETOPO 2022 (surface > 0 m) per kit cell; a cell is predicted land when the fraction is >= 0.5 and compared with the kit mask. The left-edge longitude is fitted first from the column profile of land; then, per model, the equator row and the scale (rows per unit of the model's y) by grid search in steps of 0.1.
source.notes: Measured in specs/004-map-recipes/research.md R2. Cells span 2.8125 deg of longitude and about 2.18 deg of latitude; the top row reaches about 89.8 N, the bottom row about 82.3 S. The kit's own mask always decides which cells are land and ocean.
